source_review.finding: Xinference documents launch/list/terminate and a supervisor/worker topology whose support depends on engine/model combinations; PRP-safe bound routing of a reserved lease to the actual worker is a spike requirement, not a supported-feature claim.
Ray logical resources are scheduling tokens, not VRAM caps; candidate C must still measure residency and enforce physical admission.
LINE webhook ingress (raw-body signature verification, event dedupe, durable ingress before HTTP 200) is owned by the external adapter outside PRP.
LINE reply tokens are single-use and time-bounded; audio delivery needs HTTPS-accessible MP3/M4A with duration in milliseconds.
LINE push retry key applies only to the same payload and recipient; acceptance does not prove user read or delivery.
